news_summary: Oil surged 7% today on escalating Middle East airstrikes and Iran tensions, creating a tailwind for energy stocks like XOM (earnings July 31) and defense contractors like RTX (raised 2026 outlook). Tech earnings season is in full swing with AMZN, TSLA, QCOM, and CRM all reporting today or imminently; TSLA's Micron partnership signal and AMZN's AWS growth acceleration are key upside catalysts. Geopolitical risk premium is embedded in markets, supporting defense spending and energy valuations, while semiconductor supply constraints (Micron, Sandisk analyst upgrades) and AI capex cycle remain structural tailwinds. UNH sell-the-news pattern suggests healthcare sector rotation toward AI/tech.
